name: capstone-data-pipeline
description: Development shortcuts for the uv-managed Python data pipeline

scripts.setup: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('.env')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.example', '.env');" && uv python install 3.12 && uv sync --locked
scripts.db:shell: docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml exec postgres psql -U capstone -d capstone
scripts.camera:stream: ffmpeg -re -stream_loop -1 -i "samples/videos/loitering.avi" -map 0:v:0 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -tune zerolatency -an -f rtsp -rtsp_transport tcp rtsp://localhost:8554/camera_01
